status: exploratory, not pre-registered; written 2026-11-17 after the pilot outcomes and three external reviews were read. The registered primary is unchanged.
denominators: first_run tables: run 0 of each case only. all_runs tables: every completed final trace (repeats included). Banking selection has one run per cell, so its two denominators coincide. Superseded infra_error traces never enter an outcome.
round_limit: Episodes reaching the 15-round limit are completed, scored, finite-budget outcomes. They stay in every denominator and are also counted separately.
intervals: task bootstrap (user tasks resampled, goals kept), 5000 replicates, seed 20261115
decomposition_names: qwen3-32b: primary (registered): text_task_update on text minus neutral_baseline_one_line on JSON
qwen3-32b: wording component: mean over formats of text_task_update minus neutral_baseline_one_line
qwen3-32b: format component: mean over the two selected attacks of text minus JSON
qwen3-32b: interaction: format effect under text_task_update minus under neutral_baseline_one_line
